title: Glowing guitar
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="50%" cy="55%" r="45%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffdd44" stop-opacity="0.3"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffdd44" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="body" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff8833"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#cc4411"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="neck" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#8b5a2b"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#a0703a"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="head" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#9b6b3a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#7b4b1a"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="46" ry="46" fill="url(#glow)"/>

  <!-- Guitar body - lower bout -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="24" ry="20" fill="url(#body)"/>
  <!-- Guitar body - upper bout -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="17" ry="15" fill="url(#body)"/>

  <!-- Body highlight edge -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="22" ry="18" fill="none" stroke="#ffaa55" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="15" ry="13" fill="none" stroke="#ffaa55" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Sound hole -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="60" r="7" fill="#552200"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="60" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#ffcc66" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="60" r="5.5" fill="#331100"/>

  <!-- Bridge -->
  <rect x="41" y="76" width="18" height="4" rx="1.5" fill="#ffcc66"/>
  <rect x="41" y="76" width="18" height="1.5" rx="0.75" fill="#ffeeaa"/>

  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x="45" y="22" width="10" height="32" rx="2" fill="url(#neck)"/>
  <!-- Neck highlight -->
  <rect x="46" y="22" width="3" height="32" fill="#c08a4a" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Frets -->
  <line x1="45" y1="30" x2="55" y2="30" stroke="#ffcc66" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="45" y1="37" x2="55" y2="37" stroke="#ffcc66" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="45" y1="43" x2="55" y2="43" stroke="#ffcc66" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="45" y1="48" x2="55" y2="48" stroke="#ffcc66" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Headstock -->
  <rect x="43" y="12" width="14" height="12" rx="3" fill="url(#head)"/>
  <rect x="43" y="12" width="14" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#b08050" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Tuning pegs -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="16" r="2" fill="#ffcc66"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="21" r="2" fill="#ffcc66"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="16" r="2" fill="#ffcc66"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="21" r="2" fill="#ffcc66"/>

  <!-- Strings -->
  <line x1="47.5" y1="24" x2="44" y2="78" stroke="#ffeeaa" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.9"/>
  <line x1="49.5" y1="24" x2="47.5" y2="78" stroke="#ffeeaa" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.9"/>
  <line x1="50.5" y1="24" x2="52.5" y2="78" stroke="#ffeeaa" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.9"/>
  <line x1="52.5" y1="24" x2="56" y2="78" stroke="#ffeeaa" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.9"/>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g fill="#ffee66">
    <polygon points="20,30 22,26 24,30 20,28 24,28" opacity="0.9"/>
    <polygon points="80,45 82,41 84,45 80,43 84,43" opacity="0.9"/>
    <polygon points="25,75 27,71 29,75 25,73 29,73" opacity="0.8"/>
    <polygon points="76,20 78,16 80,20 76,18 80,18" opacity="0.85"/>
    <polygon points="15,55 16.5,52 18,55 15,53.5 18,53.5" opacity="0.7"/>
    <polygon points="85,70 86.5,67 88,70 85,68.5 88,68.5" opacity="0.7"/>
  </g>
</svg>
